description: This file contains the implementation of admin notification handling in the Mattermost server, including functions for saving notifications, checking notification eligibility, sending admin notification posts, and grouping notification data.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main application struct providing methods for admin notifications and related operations.

methods.name: SaveAdminNotification
methods.description: Saves an admin notification request for a user, checking if the user has already been notified for the required feature.

methods.name: DoCheckForAdminNotifications
methods.description: Checks and triggers notifications for admin based on current license and trial status.

methods.name: SaveAdminNotifyData
methods.description: Persists admin notification data into the store.

methods.name: SendNotifyAdminPosts
methods.description: Sends notification posts to system admins about account or feature upgrades.

methods.name: upgradePlanAdminNotifyPost
methods.description: Creates and sends a notification post to an admin about a plan upgrade or trial.

methods.name: UserAlreadyNotifiedOnRequiredFeature
methods.description: Checks if a user has already been notified about a specific feature.

methods.name: CanNotifyAdmin
methods.description: Determines if the system is allowed to notify admins based on last notification timestamp and cool-off period.

methods.name: FinishSendAdminNotifyPost
methods.description: Finalizes the notification process by updating timestamps and cleaning up sent notifications.

methods.name: groupNotifyAdminByUser
methods.description: Groups notification data by user ID.

methods.name: groupNotifyAdminByPaidFeature
methods.description: Groups notification data by required feature, excluding plugin features.

methods.name: groupNotifyAdminByPlugin
methods.description: Groups notification data by plugin ID for plugin-related features.
